subject: lower=0 constrain needed for scale parameters?

messages.author: e1c430550f86b1f6
messages.subject: lower=0 constrain needed for scale parameters?
parts:
Hi all,

It's a bit of a dump question.

Re Manual v 2.7.0:

Under the "Regression Models" of the manual (Ch 5),

the scale parameters of fitted normal processes are typically specified with <lower=0> constrain (e.g. pg 42)

But, under "Time-Series Models"->"Autoregressive Models" of the manual (Ch 6.1)

<lower=0> is not used for specifying sigma (e.g. pg 77)

Is there any rationale to this?

Many thanks,

Andy

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: lower=0 constrain needed for scale parameters?
parts:
That's just a typo. Thanks for pointing it out. I added it to the issue for changes for the next manual.

Jonah
